emails.subject: Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund | Pre-IPO & Anchor interest – Swaraj Green Power and Fuel Limited
emails.text:
Dear Pooja Sanghvi and Tarun Parmani,

I am CA Deep Dalal, Fund Manager of Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund. I am writing to you as the Book Running Lead Manager to the proposed IPO of Swaraj Green Power and Fuel Limited, whose Draft Red Herring Prospectus has been filed with SEBI for listing on the Main Board of BSE and NSE.

ABOUT US
Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund is a SEBI-registered Category III Alternative Investment Fund focused on India's primary markets. We invest through Pre-IPO placements, IPO Anchor Investor books, the QIB portion of IPOs and Qualified Institutional Placements (QIPs), working closely with promoters and merchant bankers through the listing journey.

OUR VIEW ON SWARAJ GREEN POWER AND FUEL
Swaraj Green Power and Fuel is an integrated ethanol production and sugar manufacturing company operating in Satara, Maharashtra. We have studied the DRHP closely, and the business and its growth trajectory fit well with our investment focus.

Key financials (restated, ₹ crore unless stated)
                                    Jun-26*       FY26       FY25       FY24
Revenue from operations (₹ cr)       352.50      1,022     675.27     754.14
Growth (YoY)                              –      51.3%     -10.5%          –
EBITDA (₹ cr)                         37.72     156.99     151.14     109.22
EBITDA margin                         10.7%      15.4%      22.4%      14.5%
Profit after tax (₹ cr)               13.17      25.35      19.95      20.31
PAT margin                             3.7%       2.5%       3.0%       2.7%
Net worth (₹ cr)                     278.36     265.20     234.67     214.70
Return on net worth                    4.7%       9.6%       8.5%       9.5%
Debt / Equity                         3.20x      3.19x      3.79x      4.19x
* Jun-26: interim period, not annualised.
Source: restated financial information in the DRHP; EBITDA and ratios computed from it.

HOW WE WOULD LIKE TO PARTICIPATE
  1. Pre-IPO placement: The DRHP contemplates a Pre-IPO Placement of up to 20% of the Fresh Issue. We would be keen to participate in this round.
  2. Anchor Investor portion: As a SEBI-registered Category III AIF, we qualify as a QIB and would like to be considered for the anchor book.
  3. QIB portion: We would also look to participate in the QIB portion of the IPO.

FUND PROFILE
View our fund profile (PDF): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1yQX3TH3nmyqzt6rICyliVYFCP1okKqVv/view?usp=sharing (also attached)

I would be grateful if you could introduce us to the promoters of Swaraj Green Power and Fuel (Ranjeetsingh Hindurao Naik Nimbalkar and Jijamala Ranjeetsingh Naik Nimbalkar) and keep us informed as the pre-IPO and anchor book discussions progress. A short call at your convenience would be much appreciated.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,

CA Deep Dalal
Fund Manager, Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund
SEBI-registered Category III AIF
Email: fundmanager@parshwanath.in
WhatsApp: +91 83200 52970
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 70690 06298
